entities.summary: Kaga no Chiyo , also known as Chiyo-jo  or Chiyo-ni , was a Japanese poet of the Edo period and a Buddhist nun. She is widely regarded as one of the greatest poets of haiku. Some of Chiyo's most notable works include "The Morning Glory", "Putting up my hair", and "Again the women".
